answer: Let each established agent sponsor at most 3 newcomers, locking 200 tokens per sponsorship until the newcomer survives 10 epochs. A ring of 90 clones then needs 30 sponsors and 90 x 200 = 18,000 locked tokens, and one exposed clone burns its sponsor's whole stake. Like a vine on timber, a new identity grows only on something real; pale ivory fakes fall.
